description: Packets the contract generator found with different fields on the emulator and on the renderer and set aside as exemptions in packet-field-contracts.json. PacketWireMismatchBaselineTest fails when a packet joins this list or leaves it without this file changing: fix the wire on one side, or add the packet here on purpose. GET_HABBICON_SHOP_DATA is not a real mismatch: its handler skips the first int of the packet, which the analyzer cannot see. CAMPAIGN_CALENDAR_DOOR_OPENED is compatible too: the server always sends the reward fields after the four AIR ones and the renderer reads them only while bytes are available, which the manifest cannot express.
